contents.text: According to Oracle's statement of stockholders' equity, how much in common stock dividends did Oracle declare in fiscal 2025?

Oracle declared $0 in common stock dividends in fiscal 2025, as there is no mention of common stock dividends in the excerpt for fiscal 2025. (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART IV > Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules)
